name: inplay_hit_rate_v1
description: Primary objective for the pm_inplay_hit_rate_mult sweep: root-cause fix for the measured hits over-projection (~10pt on hits_1plus, +6pt hits_2plus per the 44-day backfill scorecard). Targets hits_1plus/2plus brier+logloss directly (the actual diagnosed defect) rather than the light logistic calibration already promoted, with totals MAE as a secondary check since in-play hit rate feeds the same run environment, and a starter-workload sanity term so a hits win doesn't quietly regress the already-promoted Phase 1 #1 fix.
